comments: Compilation of three texts: (1) slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i lugs kyi smon 'jug gi sems kyi cho ga; (2) smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa; (3) dbu ba lugs su grags pa'i sems bskyed brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba.
alternative_names: smon 'jug gi sems skyed kyi cho ga byed tshul
name: smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi cho ga
